output.summary: Ticket records contradict deprioritisation of Arts: matched on category and priority, Arts is within 0.3 days of others. The gap comes mainly from SlotBook tickets (42% of Arts tickets) auto-routed to P4 under RR-17, which closes 70% of the gap. The rest comes from Tuesday/Thursday-only on-site cover at Lindqvist, and Education shows the same pattern. Volume is not fully explained by SlotBook, and duplicate rates are normal. The P4 acknowledgement gives no priority or timeframe. Whether Arts leadership was told of RR-17 is undetermined. Best actions are to agree SlotBook's support status, fix the acknowledgement and report split metrics. Blanket P4 is harmful, and a separate desk or decommissioning is premature.
